name: Superwhisper
tagline: AI voice-to-text for dictating in any app, with the option to run fully offline.
about: Superwhisper is a dictation app for desktop and mobile. Custom modes reformat what you say for emails, notes or messages, and it can use on-device models.
pros: Can run offline on your device.
Custom modes reformat speech for different kinds of writing.
cons: On-device models need a reasonably powerful device.
